name: voice_agent_test_platform
description: Future MCP tool surface for controlling the bot QA platform from Codex, Claude, or another MCP client.

tools.name: generate_test_suite
tools.description: Generate chat and voice test cases from a bot profile, flow docs, intents, logs, or Yellow.ai exports.

bot_profile.description: Bot name, business goal, channels, flow docs, intents, FAQs, and known constraints.

tools.name: run_test_suite
tools.description: Run a generated suite across chat, voice, or both channels.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Fetch a report with scores, transcripts, metrics, and recommendations.

tools.name: suggest_yellow_ai_changes
tools.description: Convert failed test findings into recommended Yellow.ai flow, intent, entity, or fallback changes.
